prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: isolated raster layer for a scroll-driven PC assembly on a website
Input images: Image 1 is the assembled PC reference and fixes camera angle, coordinate system, scale, materials and warm-yellow lighting. Image 2 is the product-shape reference for this component.
Primary request: Generate one realistic large black triple-fan gaming graphics card with restrained warm-yellow edge accents as the only visible object. It must visually match Image 1 and be ready to overlay at 100% canvas size.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key magenta #FF00FF from edge to edge.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 canvas. Place it horizontally in the lower-middle interior coordinate of the 4:5 canvas, centered around x=44%, y=62%, occupying about 48% of canvas width and 16% of canvas height; same slight three-quarter perspective and scale as the installed GPU in the reference PC.
Style/medium: true photorealistic premium product photography, physically plausible hardware, crisp real materials, correct connectors and geometry.
Lighting/mood: same low-key studio lighting and warm-yellow accent glow as Image 1. Do not illuminate or gradient the magenta background.
Constraints: only this isolated component; no case, no motherboard, no desk, no floor, no extra hardware, no labels, no brand logos, no text, no watermark. Hard clean silhouette. No cast shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no haze. Background must be exactly solid #FF00FF everywhere outside the component. Preserve placement and scale so full-canvas layers align with Image 1.
